svg.title: Speculative Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 174-175, PDF 175-176. Main-deck external envelope retains broad swept cargo wings, narrow projecting forward bridge and paired aft machinery bodies around recessed stern. Separate rectangular top fuel deck sits within the main hull footprint; placement is interpreted from illustration and does not enlarge envelope. Bow right in source, rotated up. Interior divisions and detached turret symbols excluded.
